summary:
We have developed “Mars Explorers,” an interactive and educational web experience that tells the story of the Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity rovers. Rather than simply presenting text, we have transformed data from NASA’s missions into engaging activities for children, teens, and adults alike.

We have taken on the challenge of “Abandoned, but Not Forgotten” by reviving the legacy of the rovers that are no longer operational and showcasing their achievements in an accessible and memorable way, with the goal of sharing information about some of the missions that have been pushed to the sidelines of space exploration history.

This is important because it brings students and space enthusiasts closer to missions that once seemed distant, fostering active learning and science outreach while serving as a source of inspiration. It demonstrates that their discoveries—such as evidence of liquid water in Mars’s past—continue to pave the way for future missions.
details:
Mars Explorers is an interactive educational website that teaches users about the history and achievements of the Mars rovers Sojourner, Spirit, and Opportunity. It allows visitors to explore rover components, simulate landing sequences, test space technologies, and navigate the Martian surface while collecting scientific samples.

The project promotes learning through interactive activities instead of traditional reading. Its main benefits are making space exploration easier to understand, encouraging scientific curiosity, and inspiring students to explore STEM careers.

We hope to increase public interest in Mars exploration and preserve the legacy of these missions for future generations.

The website was developed using HTML5, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, along with Interactive SVG, Web Audio API, Font Awesome, and Google Fonts. It is creative because it combines real scientific information with simulations, challenges, a quiz, and personalized certificates.

Our team considered accessibility, educational value, user interaction, and responsive design to create an engaging experience for students and space enthusiasts.
